resourceProfile.assessment: Canonical English, complete effective es-419 exports, runtime-expanded catalog presentations, glossary, protected-token rules, and three fresh independent machine critiques were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation checks, type checking, 459 non-queue tests, the production build, route checks, and generated-link checks passed while the cycle was active.

linguisticCritique.summary: Three independent machine iterations identified and resolved 61 actionable findings before the bounded run limit.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Latin American Spanish human review was performed; corrections remain machine reviewed.

publicationAuthorization.summary: The owner requested continued improvement and a commit, not publication or deployment.

findings.summary: Corrected battery, material, and mod dictionaries were exported but stale draft dictionaries had already been expanded into encyclopedia presentations.
evidence: Affected battery notes 71, 77–92, and 94–96, material.safety.verifiedProfile, and mod profiles 235 and 237.
findings.resolution: Re-expanded all three es-419 presentation categories from the corrected dictionaries and wired corrected dictionaries into the exported translation maps.

findings.summary: Nineteen battery evidence notes lost ampere units or distorted tabless, temperature-limited, rewrap, and production-revision meaning.
evidence: The independent pass checked notes for batteries 71, 77–92, and 94–96 against canonical English.
findings.resolution: Made every corrected safety note effective at runtime with units, identities, and evidence limits intact.

findings.summary: Several mod profiles mistranslated cell count, adapters, integrated batteries, control boards, or left English construction syntax.
findings.resolution: Retranslated the affected profiles and preserved product identities and electrical limits.

findings.summary: Reset actions used Reiniciar, suggesting a restart rather than restoring state.
evidence: Affected shared error, Ohm, battery, coil, juice, mod-range, TCR, and Wire Wizard reset labels.

findings.summary: Thirteen section formulas had been replaced with bare strings, so the renderer received no expression property.
evidence: Affected Kirchhoff series, voltage, and cell formulas plus trigonometry ratio, inverse, and radians formulas.
findings.resolution: Restored ConceptFormula objects and assigned through their expression properties.

findings.summary: Shared UI retained duplicate punctuation, wrong curve-sort wording, unsafe grammatical gender, and inconsistent voltage terminology.
evidence: Covered old-version note, normalization help, voltage labels, visibility states, catalog used-by text, and count agreement.
findings.resolution: Corrected concatenation, wording, gender neutrality, plural handling, and LatAm voltaje terminology.

findings.summary: Concept instructions mixed formal imperatives into an informal-tú locale.
evidence: Affected Ohm, TCR, SI, heat-flux, Kirchhoff, trigonometry, wire-gauge, and material-safety instructions.
findings.resolution: Normalized the identified instructions to clear informal imperatives.

findings.summary: Concept headings and prose retained calques, inconsistent Joule terminology, lowercase titles, punctuation, and awkward technical phrasing.
evidence: Covered Ohm headings/example, Joule terminology, Kirchhoff solving title, heat headings, TCR mechanical strain, and wire-gauge headings.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the affected headings and passages with consistent Latin American technical Spanish.

findings.summary: Static concepts used Spain-style decimal commas and period grouping while Intl.NumberFormat(es-419) uses decimal points and comma grouping.
evidence: The exhaustive pass covered 61 paths across all seven concepts and verified Intl.NumberFormat(es-419).
findings.resolution: Normalized every identified static value and formula to es-419 punctuation without changing numeric identity.

findings.summary: Twelve effective concept strings displayed literal Unicode escape text instead of Ω, α, Δ, and °.
evidence: The runtime scan enumerated every remaining literal escape path.
findings.resolution: Replaced every identified literal escape with its actual symbol.

findings.summary: Wire Wizard retained adjective-only result headings, dormant title conflicts, and lowercase Clapton.
evidence: Affected electrical, thermal, coilParametersTitle, wireDesignTitle, and clapton.
findings.resolution: Aligned headings with visible terms and preserved the Clapton construction name.

findings.summary: Median resistance, TCR normalization help, and battery authenticity agreement remained inaccurate.
findings.resolution: Used Resistencia mediana, neutral normalization wording, and feminine Verificada.

findings.summary: The Joule example used bobina and the unnatural electrical verb transporta.
evidence: The locale glossary uses resistencia for the heating element.
findings.resolution: Used Una resistencia de 0.8 Ω conduce 3 A and aligned the conclusion.

findings.summary: SI, imperial, heat-capacity, heat-flux, TCR, trigonometry, Ohm, and Kirchhoff examples had inconsistent localized values.
evidence: The exhaustive path audit covered every table cell, setup, formula, conclusion, prefix, and conversion value.
findings.resolution: Made units, grouping, decimals, symbols, and percent spacing consistent and unambiguous.

findings.summary: Six corrected dictionary values and eleven expanded catalog consumers used the wrong es-419 numeric punctuation.
evidence: Affected battery 82 and mod presets 231, 234, 235, 236, and 237.
findings.resolution: Corrected the source dictionaries and regenerated their expanded presentation fan-out.
